title: Putnami Private Keyring
description: A private-keyring document: the versioned set of signing keys, each of which may carry private key material and a lifecycle state. It is the owner-side document; a verifier receives only its public JWKS projection (putnami-jwks.json). Private key material (d, p, q, dp, dq, qi, k) lives ONLY here and is never projected into the public JWKS.

keys.description: The signing keys held by this keyring.

keyState.description: Key lifecycle state. Closed enum. active = sign+verify; retiring = verify-only rollover grace; revoked = compromised/withdrawn (terminal, never published); expired = past validity (never published).

keyType.description: JWK key type. 'oct' is a symmetric key that never appears in a public JWKS.

privateJwk.description: A JSON Web Key that may carry private material. base64url (unpadded) encodes every parameter except crv.

retiredAt.description: RFC 3339 instant a retiring key entered its overlap window (keyring-local; never projected to the public JWK). Empty unless retiring.
